card: Fixes the test_orphanage_dos_many functional test so that it properly saturates the orphan pool and triggers eviction. Previously, 60 peers sent duplicate orphans via tx messages, which were ignored without recording announcers, causing the orphanage to peak at 152 out of 3000 announcements and rendering the eviction test ineffective. By having peers announce via inv instead, the test reaches the 3000 announcement limit and actively verifies that an honest peer's orphan survives eviction.
evidence: PR description: 'The orphanage peaks at 152 announcements against a limit of 3000, so nothing is evicted.'
PR description: 'If LimitOrphans is changed to evict the normal peer's orphan first, the test used to pass and now fails.'
problem: In `test_orphanage_dos_many`, 60 peers sent duplicate orphans as `tx` messages, but Bitcoin Core drops duplicate orphan transactions without registering the subsequent senders. As a result, the orphanage reached only 152 announcements out of the 3000 limit, never triggering eviction and allowing the test to pass vacuously even if orphan eviction logic was broken.

risk.why: Only touches a functional test script; a bug could cause test flakiness or false test failures.

scope_notes: Diff touches only a single functional test file.
summary: Fixes the `test_orphanage_dos_many` functional test so that it actually fills the orphan transaction pool to capacity and triggers eviction. The test now has flooding peers announce duplicate orphans using `inv` messages rather than `tx` messages, ensuring all peers are registered as announcers and reaching the 3000-announcement limit.
